scripts.start: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs citizen && ng serve frontend --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
scripts.start:admin: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs admin && ng serve frontend --port 4300 --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
scripts.start:worker: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs worker && ng serve frontend --port 4400 --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs citizen && ng build frontend
scripts.build:admin: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs admin && ng build frontend --output-path dist/admin
scripts.build:worker: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs worker && ng build frontend --output-path dist/worker
scripts.dev: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs citizen && ng serve frontend --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
